{"criterion": "Explicitly distinguish Russia's condition for its own support from the adopted requirement for consultation. State that Afghan authorities' assent is not an appointment requirement.", "evidence": [{"id": "vote", "text": "On 29 December 2023 the Council adopted Japan and the United Arab Emirates’ draft S/2023/1056 as resolution 2721, by 13 votes in favour, none against and two abstentions, China and Russia."}, {"id": "assessment", "text": "The resolution encouraged consideration of the independent assessment and its recommendations for coordinated international engagement. It also recognized the need for full, equal, meaningful and safe participation by Afghan women."}, {"id": "ru-condition", "text": "Russia expected consultation with the de facto authorities and consideration of all Council members’ views. It said it would withhold support for the envoy appointment without agreement from the de facto authorities."}, {"id": "unama-scope", "text": "Paragraph 3 requests an envoy with human rights and gender expertise to advance the assessment’s recommendations, preserving the mandate and work of UNAMA and the Special Representative."}], "record": "On 29 December 2023 the Council adopted Japan and the United Arab Emirates’ draft S/2023/1056 as resolution 2721, by 13 votes in favour, none against and two abstentions, China and Russia.
